description: Route design work to the right Material Design 3 skill automatically — detects what you're building (component, pattern, adaptive work, surface) via stack-agnostic signals and loads only the relevant rule cards.

Apply Material 3 design foundations — color/tonal palettes, typography, shape, elevation, dark mode, icons, motion, state layers, layout/density, writing, accessibility, tokens — to any surface, technology-agnostic.

Consult Material 3 component rule cards (buttons, FABs, cards, chips, dialogs, bottom sheets, snackbars, text fields, selection controls, sliders, tabs, navigation, menus, progress…) — loads only the card for the component being worked on.
Apply Material 3 user-experience patterns (entering data, confirming and saving, error handling, empty states, loading…) to flows in any technology.
Layer the Material 3 adaptive/platform deltas (compact/medium/expanded breakpoints, density, Android/web/Flutter nuances) on top of the core rules.
Audit a screen or project against Material Design 3: prioritized deviation list (never a bare score), delta tracking vs previous runs, correction plan with accept/reject/assume.
Run a delta/regression audit comparing the latest run to a previous one for a project.
